description: This Java source file defines the 'Unifier' class used for pattern matching and unification of Java code elements within the IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment, specifically for Android navigation macro processing.

classes.name: Unifier
classes.description: Main class providing pattern matching and unification functionalities for Java code elements.

classes.name: Unifier.Matcher
classes.description: Inner class extending JavaElementVisitor to perform pattern matching on Java PSI elements.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to match a PsiMethod against a PsiElement, returning variable bindings if successful.

methods.name: unify
methods.description: Performs unification of method parameters and body with a candidate PsiElement, returning variable bindings.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Generates indentation string based on current indentation level for debugging.

methods.name: getBindings
methods.description: Returns the current variable bindings if valid, otherwise null.
